seoTitle: Founding Member Program - Early Access | Tradify
seoDesc: Join Tradify's Founding Member program. Get 1 month free Pro access, 30% lifetime discount, influence the roadmap, and earn your permanent founder badge. First 500 users only.
subheading: The first 500 users who sign up automatically become Founding Members — no form, no waitlist. Just create your account before spots run out.
fullDesc: The founding member program is now closed. You can still create a free account.
noEmailNeeded: No email submission needed — just sign up and founding member status is applied automatically.
freeNoCard: Free to start · No credit card required
benefit1Desc: Full access to Pro features automatically granted when you sign up. No upfront commitment required.
benefit2Desc: Secure a 30% discounted subscription rate, maintained for as long as your subscription remains active.
benefit3Desc: Provide structured feedback, help prioritize features, and contribute to the product's early development cycle.
benefit4Desc: A permanent founding member identifier displayed on your profile — locked in forever.
footerTagline: Trading Discipline Platform — Your Rules. Enforced.
